products.name: Organic Tulsi (Holy Basil)
products.description: Farm-fresh Rama and Krishna tulsi varieties, shade-dried to preserve essential oils. Known as the Queen of Herbs for its adaptogenic and immune-boosting properties.

products.name: Ashwagandha Root Powder
products.description: Premium KSM-66 ashwagandha root powder, organically grown and lab-verified for withanolide content. Supports stress relief, better sleep, and enhanced physical performance.

products.name: Turmeric Root Powder
products.description: High-curcumin turmeric powder from Lakadong variety, containing 7-12% curcumin. Anti-inflammatory powerhouse for cooking, golden milk, and traditional remedies.

products.name: Dried Lemongrass
products.description: Aromatic lemongrass stalks, sun-dried and cut for easy brewing. Makes a refreshing tea that aids digestion, relieves anxiety, and naturally repels insects.

products.name: Moringa Leaf Powder
products.description: Nutrient-dense moringa oleifera leaves, shade-dried and finely ground. Contains 92 nutrients, 46 antioxidants, and all essential amino acids. A true superfood for smoothies and meals.

products.name: Pure Frankincense Resin
products.description: Premium Boswellia sacra resin hand-harvested from ancient trees in the Himalayan region. Ideal for meditation, aromatherapy, and traditional Ayurvedic preparations. Rich in boswellic acids.

products.name: Benzoin Sumatra Resin
products.description: Aromatic Styrax benzoin resin with sweet vanilla-like fragrance. Used in incense making, perfumery, and as a natural preservative. Sustainably wild-crafted from Indonesian forests.

products.name: Myrrh Gum Resin
products.description: Premium Commiphora myrrha resin with earthy, balsamic aroma. Traditionally used for oral health, meditation, and skin care formulations. Ethically sourced from African collectors.

products.name: Copal Amber Resin
products.description: Young amber copal resin from Bursera trees with fresh pine-citrus scent. Perfect for energy cleansing ceremonies and natural varnish production. Clean burning with minimal smoke.

products.name: Dragon's Blood Resin
products.description: Vibrant red Daemonorops draco resin prized for its deep crimson color. Used in ritual magic, as a natural dye, and in traditional Chinese medicine for wound healing and blood circulation.

products.name: Neem Oil (Cold Pressed)
products.description: Pure cold-pressed neem oil rich in azadirachtin. Natural pesticide, fungicide, and miticide for organic gardening. Also excellent for skin conditions like acne and eczema.

products.name: Sesame Seed Oil
products.description: Traditional wood-pressed sesame oil (gingelly oil) with nutty aroma. Rich in vitamin E and antioxidants. Ideal for cooking, oil pulling therapy, and Ayurvedic body massage (abhyanga).

products.name: Coconut Oil (Virgin)
products.description: Extra virgin coconut oil from fresh kernel cold-pressing. MCT-rich for energy and metabolism support. Multipurpose for cooking, hair conditioning, skin moisturizing, and oil pulling.

products.name: Castor Oil (Hexane Free)
products.description: Premium hexane-free castor oil extracted through traditional pressing. Promotes hair growth, treats constipation, and reduces inflammation. Excellent base for herbal infusions and balms.

products.name: Almond Oil (Sweet)
products.description: Cold-pressed sweet almond oil rich in omega fatty acids and vitamin E. Lightweight carrier oil perfect for aromatherapy blends, massage, and as a gentle makeup remover.

products.name: Fenugreek Seeds (Methi)
products.description: Premium quality fenugreek seeds with high coumarin content. Used in spice blends, hair growth treatments, and to support digestive health and lactation. Easy to sprout for microgreens.

products.name: Cumin Seeds (Jeera)
products.description: Aromatic whole cumin seeds with intense earthy flavor. Essential for Indian, Middle Eastern, and Mexican cuisines. Known for aiding digestion and boosting immunity naturally.

products.name: Mustard Seeds (Black)
products.description: Pungent black mustard seeds (Rai) for tempering and pickling. Generates heat when crushed - excellent for winter cooking. Traditional remedy for colds and joint pain when used in poultices.

products.name: Chia Seeds (Organic)
products.description: Nutrient-dense organic chia seeds packed with omega-3, fiber, and protein. Creates satisfying gel when soaked - perfect for puddings, smoothies, and egg replacement in vegan baking.

products.name: Flax Seeds (Alsi)
products.description: Brown flaxseeds (linseeds) rich in lignans and ALA omega-3. Ground flax is a nutritious egg substitute and supports heart health. Store refrigerated for maximum freshness.

testimonials.name: Priya Sharma
testimonials.text: The Organic Tulsi and Ashwagandha Root Powder are exceptional quality. I recommend these to my patients regularly - you can tell they are genuinely organic and carefully processed with high potency.

testimonials.name: Dr. Rajesh Patel
testimonials.text: The Frankincense Resin has transformed my meditation practice. The aroma is pure and long-lasting. Combined with their Neem Oil for my skincare routine, this is my go-to source for authentic Ayurvedic products.

testimonials.name: Anita Desai
testimonials.text: The Chia Seeds and Fenugreek Seeds have become staples in my kitchen. Great germination rate when I tried sprouting them! The Cold Pressed Oils collection is outstanding - you can taste the freshness and purity.
